about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of Brazil: 26 states and the Federal District (DF), one region each. See docs/REGIONS-BR.md.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:BR unit codes, BR-AC to BR-TO (the prefix BR- and two letters).
codes.why: Seven two-letter codes (AL, MA, MS, MT, PA, PR, SC) are also codes in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py) for US states or Puerto Rico. carry_over() in engine/setup/install.py keeps only [A-Z]{2} address indexes (line 335), so the hyphenated name must be decided before any index is shipped.
codes.verified: The ISO 3166-2:BR codes were not checked against the ISO site in this change.

boxes.source: IBGE state polygons (malhas territoriais, estadual), read through the IBGE malhas API with qualidade=maxima on 2026-11-20.
boxes.method: Every vertex of every polygon was read; the box was widened by 0.15 degrees and rounded outward to 0.01 degrees, the same margin map_sets.state uses for US states.
boxes.licence_status: Not settled. No explicit open licence was found for the IBGE malhas; the IBGE technical and legal note was not read. Boxes are a proposal until that is checked.

open_questions: DF is inside the BR-GO box: separate maps, or the GO map includes DF (as the Argentina proposal suggests for CABA)?
Should BR- hyphenated codes become file and manifest names, with carry_over widened to match?
Does the IBGE technical and legal note for the state malha allow a copy in a build?
Is there an open source for CEP (postal-code) areas, so address indexes can be split by state?
